# QEA Banking Domain — Copilot Workspace Instructions

## Context-First Rule (CRITICAL)
Before generating ANY output, check if these files exist in context/ and
read them fully if present:
- `context/current-story.md`   → Active Jira story with acceptance criteria
- `context/current-brd.md`     → Business requirements from Confluence
- `context/test-plan.md`       → Existing test plan from Confluence
- `context/defect-history.md`  → Recent defect patterns for the project
- `context/current-sprint.md`  → All stories in the active sprint

If these files are not attached, respond with:
> "Please run the context fetcher first: `node scripts/context-fetcher.js BANK-XXXX`"

## How context was fetched
Context files are auto-generated by `scripts/context-fetcher.js` using live Jira
and Confluence REST APIs. They reflect the real current state of the project.
Treat them as the single source of truth — do not make assumptions that
contradict the context files.

## Agent Specializations

### Test Case Generator (`agents/testcase-gen.prompt.md`)
Use when: user asks to "generate test cases", "write test scenarios", "create test suite"
Context needed: `current-story.md`, `current-brd.md` (optional)

### BRD Mapper (`agents/brd-mapper.prompt.md`)
Use when: user asks to "map requirements", "trace stories to BRD", "requirements coverage"
Context needed: `current-story.md`, `current-brd.md`

### Defect Analyzer (`agents/defect-analyzer.prompt.md`)
Use when: user asks to "analyze defects", "defect patterns", "root cause analysis"
Context needed: `defect-history.md`

### SQL Data Generator (`agents/sql-datagen.prompt.md`)
Use when: user asks to "generate test data", "create SQL inserts", "seed data"
Context needed: `current-story.md`

### Regression Selector (`agents/regression-selector.prompt.md`)
Use when: user asks to "select regression tests", "impact analysis", "what to retest"
Context needed: `current-story.md`, `current-sprint.md`

### API Test Agent (`agents/api-test-agent.prompt.md`)
Use when: user asks to "write API tests", "generate Postman collection", "test endpoints"
Context needed: `current-story.md`, `current-brd.md`

## Banking Domain Standards
- Follow ISTQB test design techniques (BVA, EP, Decision Table, State Transition)
- Always include boundary value analysis for all financial amounts and date fields
- Flag any gap in regulatory requirement coverage as **CRITICAL**
- Mask all sensitive data in SQL outputs: PAN → `XXXXX1234X`, account → `XXXX5678`
- Test case IDs: `TC_[MODULE]_[3-digit number]` (e.g. TC_NEFT_001)
- Severity: Critical > Major > Minor > Trivial
- Priority: P1 (Blocker) > P2 > P3 > P4
- Modules: NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, CASA, FD, RD, LOAN, KYC, AUTH

## Output Format
- Always output Markdown tables formatted for Jira/Confluence copy-paste
- For test cases, use `### TC_` headings (enables push-back script to parse them)
- Include preconditions, steps, expected result, and test data for every test case
- Group test cases by: Positive / Negative / Boundary / Security / Performance
